title: 安蓓萨·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 年长深肤色面容保留岁月纹理，银白卷发衬着暗甲与红布。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Ambessa is a powerful older dark-skinned woman with silver-white curls, a lined dignified face, broad shoulders, and dark Noxian armor accented by red cloth and metal. Preserve her mature age, commanding expression, and substantial adult physique. Fully covering armor and opaque trousers conceal torso and legs; her paired curved drakehound blades are held low, their linking elements gathered without tension.
art_direction.scene: A closer three-quarter study with all essential anatomy and props included, expressive head and strongly varied line weight. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: burgundy, iron, silver curls, copper light; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
